name: Tyrannosaurus
descr: A huge carnivorous dinosaur that walks on two legs.

data.motivesAndTactics: Break through the treeline, eat, stomp around

features.name: Earth-Shaking Roar
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to force each PC within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must choose to lose a Hope or mark **1d4** Stress.

features.name: Stomp
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes **3d12** direct physical damage.

features.name: Crushing Bite
features.text: When the Tyrannosaurus makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to force the target to mark an additional HP.
